Binary and Text Converter

Convert text to binary or hex and back, with full UTF-8 awareness and strict input validation.

UTF-8 is used throughout, so emoji and non-Latin text convert correctly.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a conversion direction from the dropdown.
  2. Type or paste your input — conversion happens live.
  3. Invalid input (bad digits, wrong length) shows a clear error.
  4. Copy the result or swap the direction with one click.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is multi-byte Unicode handled correctly?

Yes. Text is encoded and decoded as UTF-8, so emoji and non-Latin scripts round-trip correctly instead of breaking.

Why does binary input need a multiple of 8 bits?

Each byte is 8 bits. A length that is not a multiple of 8 cannot be split into whole bytes, so it is rejected.

Are spaces allowed in binary or hex input?

Yes — spaces and line breaks are ignored, so you can paste grouped output like “01001000 01101001” directly.
